<h2 id="howtouse">How to Use Sci-Hub</h2>
<ul>
  <li>1. Find Your Paper</li>
  <small>Search for the research paper on <a href="https://scholar.google.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Google Scholar</a> or a similar academic database.</small>
  <li>2. Locate the Identifier</li>
  <small>Find the paper's DOI (e.g., 10.1002/anie.202301234) or its direct URL. </small>
  <li>3. Find the Sci-Hub Website</li>
  <small>Visit any working <a href="/">Sci-Hub mirror</a>.</small>
  <li>4. Paste & Access</li>
  <small>Paste the DOI or URL into the search bar on the Sci-Hub site and click "Open" or press Enter.</small>
  <li>5. Download</li>
  <small>The full paper (often as a PDF) should load, allowing you to download it. </small>
</ul>

<h2 id="alternatives">Sci-Hub Alternatives</h2>
<ul>
  <li><a href="https://annas-archive.gd/?r=4LpPZnU" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Annas Archive</a> - The largest truly open library in human history.</li>
  <li><a href="https://arxiv.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">arXiv</a> - e-Print archive</li>
  <li><a href="https://core.ac.uk/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Core</a> - The worlds largest collection of open access research papers</li>
  <li><a href="https://doaj.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">DOAJ</a> - Directory of Open Access Journals</li>
  <li><a href="https://scholar.google.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Google Scholar</a> - Google Scholar</li>
  <li><a href="https://libgen.bz/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Library Genesis+</a> - Library Genesis+</li>
  <li><a href="https://library.memoryoftheworld.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Memory of the World Library</a> - Memory of the World Library</li>
  <li><a href="https://oa.mg/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">OA.mg</a>- The only truly modern academic research engine</li>
  <li><a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">PubMed Central</a> - 11.6 million articles are archived in PMC</li>
  <li><a href="https://sci-bot.ru/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Sci-Bot</a> - AI-powered research assistant</li>
  <li><a href="https://sci-net.xyz/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Sci-Net</a> - scientific communication support network</li>
  <li><a href="https://unpaywall.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Unpaywall</a> - An open database of 20 million free scholarly articles</li>
  <li><a href="https://welib.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">WeLib</a> - 43 million books, 98 million papers. All free. All yours.</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="about">About Sci-Hub</h2>
<p>Sci-Hub is the most controversial project in modern science. <br>
  The goal of Sci-Hub is to provide free and unrestricted access to all scientific knowledge. <br>
  <a href="https://www.sci-hub.pub/">Sci-Hub.Pub</a> is not affiliated with the official Sci-Hub project.
</p>
